# Capital Operator
> Open Capital Infrastructure Diagnostic & Blueprint Engine by Moonshine Capital

Capital Operator evaluates commercial debt origination, underwriting triage, document processing, and lender syndication workflows.

## Primary Entities
- Operating Models: Artisan (1), Standardized (2), Automated (3), Programmatic (4)
- 8 Operating Stages: Ingestion, Triage, Document Assembly, Credit Memo Packaging, Lender Routing, Offer Syndication, Closing / Verification, and Post-Close Relationship Equity.
- Moonshine Capital: Direct commercial debt provider and syndication desk.

  - Borrower Application: https://tally.so/r/mDEJB5
